प्लु (ङ) प्लवते 1.
d. To go; to jump.
With उत् to leap up; with वि
to plunge in.

प्लुक्षि (क्षिः) 2.
m. Fire or its deity.

प्लुत (तः) 1.
m. Bounded; leaped.
m. n. The long accent.
p. Jump-
ed, leaped; thrown up.

प्लुष् (-उ) प्लोषति 4.
d. (ऋ, य) प्लुष्यति
4.
a. To burn. (ग) प्लुष्णाति 9.
a.
To be unctuous; to sprinkle; to
fill; to set free; to be fond of.
